body: Orchestrator adversarial review of PR #304 head 689e1901 (one commit on main 52e56c89; 5 files, +110/-3), done before the push while the worker was blocked on credentials. Re-derived from the diff in worker-c: check-regime-boundary.sh gains a read-only canonical-clone section (chezmoi source-path, rev-parse --show-toplevel, skip when the clone is the working clone by pwd -P or chezmoi is absent; ref origin/main else HEAD; the three lines unmerged / stash / differs in the task order and wording, the differs set being diff --name-only <ref> plus ls-files --others --exclude-standard over home install scripts, sorted and comma-joined). The live --report paste shows the predicted positive case on this machine (3 unmerged entries, 1 stash, home/dot_mise/mise.lock). Five unit tests on the existing boundary_repo()/run_boundary_check() fixtures with a scratch canonical clone and a fake chezmoi in bin_dir; the fixture isolates the real chezmoi by PATH and HOME. SKILL boundary bullet and README sentence are the task text verbatim; .gitignore gains /.claude/worktrees/ and git check-ignore -v names .gitignore:30. Local make unit-test shows 73 failures / 10 errors that the worker proved pre-existing by running the same ids on origin/main in the same sandbox; CI is the full run. The blocked PONG was a correct report (host had no SSH identity and no gh login, confirmed independently).

Orchestrator adversarial review of PR #304 final head 0f0f2cbe (second commit, from Codex Bot P1 thread 4224481114; 2 files, +28/-1). Re-derived from the diff: when the differs line is empty, a fourth line reports uncommitted changes under home/install/scripts that already match the ref while HEAD is behind (git diff --name-only HEAD), with the instruction to pull so the autostash re-applies as a no-op; the header lists it; one new test builds that exact state (commit, move origin/main, reset HEAD~1) and asserts the line. This goes beyond the task's three specified lines and is accepted: it closes a real gap the task missed (after the pins merge the operator may run make update, which fetches but skips the pull on a dirty tree, and byte-equal pins then passed the check). Known limitation, accepted: a clean clone whose HEAD is merely behind a fetched origin/main (only possible when a fetch ran without a pull on a clean tree, which make update never does on main) gets the differs line with pins-task/restore advice rather than a plain pull hint. Push path: the worker found ~/.config/git/config url.git@github.com:.pushInsteadOf rewriting the HTTPS URL to SSH and pushed with GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null and the gh helper on the command line, changing no file. CI: 13 of 13 checks pass on 0f0f2cbe. Bot: reviewed 689e1901 and 0f0f2cbe; three threads: 4224481114 fixed:0f0f2cbe, 4224481107 and 4224555733 not-applicable with reasons in the feedback JSON; all three replied to and resolved by the orchestrator. Sweep: 11 items, every one dispositioned. CompactionDB ids 7f6094b4, a66424a3, ecccc4fc claimed with pasted output in validation R1.5.

Orchestrator adversarial review of PR #304 heads df21d590 (round 2: 3 files, +28/-4) and 46a229c6 (round 3: SKILL.md only, 1 line). Round 2, re-derived from the diff: the stash line and SKILL clause now name only the autostash entry (stash drop stash@{<n>}); git diff --cached --name-only <ref> joins the differs set and --cached HEAD the fourth line set, with the staged-only reproduction test (add, then restore --worktree --source=HEAD) expecting the differs line; the round-1 fixture moved to reset --soft so the fourth line covers index-and-worktree-equal-ref with HEAD behind, and the unstaged-equal case reports via the differs line whose restore -SW leads to the fourth line and the pull (accepted: every state is reported); the identity-proof sentence became the full-index patch headers; validation R2.1 pastes both sorted 83-line failing-id lists and an empty comm -3; the report now states the two out-of-sandbox diagnostics. Round 3, re-derived: the extraction is git diff --full-index HEAD (staged and unstaged), the added-file command carries --full-index, and the added-file pull exception with the fetch, cmp -s and removal step is stated; the orchestrator reproduced all three Bot claims in scratch repositories before tasking. CI 13 of 13 on df21d590 and on 46a229c6; Bot reviewed df21d590 (three P2 threads, fixed in 46a229c6) and none within 15 minutes on 46a229c6. All six Bot threads replied to by the orchestrator and resolved; sweep at 46a229c6: 21 items, every one dispositioned. The round-1 audit of 0f0f2cbe (incorrect, 5 P2) is dispositioned in the acceptance record: findings 1, 2, 3 and 5 fixed in df21d590, finding 4 not applicable as a worker process deviation recorded there.

Orchestrator adversarial review of PR #304 round-4 head 9b32798e (SKILL.md, 1 line) and the update-branch head 1219c53a (merge of main 64090870, #305, into the branch; its diff against origin/main is the PR content: 5 files, +162/-3). Round 4, re-derived from the diff: the extraction clause now requires git diff --cached --quiet (nothing staged) before git diff --full-index HEAD, and names the operator reconciliation for an index-only change (checkout -- <files> to carry it into the working tree, then restore --staged); the worker caught the orchestrator error that --cached compares index with HEAD and proposed this clause from a scratch probe (validation R4.1), adopted verbatim. Validation R4.2 pastes memory list for the three CompactionDB ids and memadd.sh itself; no record was added. The audit of 46a229c6 (incorrect, 2 P2) is dispositioned in the acceptance record, both fixed in 9b32798e. CI 13 of 13 on 9b32798e; Bot none within 15 minutes; gh pr update-branch 304 by the orchestrator because #305 moved main; CI, sweep and audit are repeated on 1219c53a.

Orchestrator adversarial review of PR #304 round-5 head 0003cbdf (SKILL.md, 1 line, on the update-branch head 1219c53a). Origin: the Codex Bot reviewed the round-4 head 9b32798e after the worker's 15-minute wait had ended, with one P1 (git checkout -- <files> would discard unstaged edits on a path that also has staged ones) and two P2 (the added-file no-index diff lacked -C <canonical>; the post-merge cmp dereferenced an added symlink). Re-derived from the diff: the copy step is restricted to paths whose working tree still equals HEAD (git diff --quiet HEAD -- <file>), then git restore --staged -- <files> leaves every working tree as it is; the added-file command runs with -C <canonical>; the cmp check is replaced by removing the untracked copy whose bytes acceptance already proved to be on origin/main, then pulling. The orchestrator verified the unstage procedure and the -C no-index command in a scratch repository before tasking (mixed A B and index-only G both survive and both land in the patch; full-id header from another cwd). CI 13 of 13 on 0003cbdf; Bot none within 15 minutes and at a recheck. All nine Bot threads replied to and resolved by the orchestrator; sweep at 0003cbdf: 37 items, every one dispositioned.
